Hi Mike,

Here is where both stand.

The B30 on Shop···· is in the first batch, and those units are in the US now going through customs clearance. They are due at our warehouse Wednesday, and your unit is expected to ship out early next week. You can follow that shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and tracking comes to you by email the moment the label is on the box.

The Magic Miner 40T on Shop···· was set for October 31 and that date has now passed without the units landing, so I am not going to give you a date I cannot stand behind. A colleague is picking that up today and will come back to you with the confirmed ship date.

One more thing from your last message, and you were right about it. The duplicate wave 2 line on Shop···· was taken off the order, but the money for it has not come back to you yet. I have put that in front of the team today along with the date, and they will confirm the amount and the refund with you directly.

Sorry for the wait on both.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
